mae_matched_backbone: fresh CLIP ViT-B/32, 256px, learned CLIP positions

deliberate_adaptations: fresh shared CLIP ViT-B/32 256px instead of official MAE ViT-B/16 224px
shared trainable CLIP positional embeddings and pre-layernorm instead of fixed encoder sincos positions
CLIP normalization of BOTH encoder inputs and pixel reconstruction targets for matched encoder architecture
full-patch mean readout for the shared downstream protocol
250 instead of 800 training epochs; matched to existing LeJEPA checkpoint budget
batch 128 instead of official 4096; base learning rate linearly scaled to effective batch
single GPU no distributed training; decoder architecture matched using native PyTorch blocks rather than official timm
source_metadata.paper: He et al. Masked Autoencoders Are Scalable Vision Learners CVPR 2022
